name: Thyroid surgery
summary: How expats evaluate thyroidectomy and related surgery in Singapore — nodule workups, voice-risk counselling, and coordination with endocrinology before and after the OR.
body:
Thyroid surgery sits after ultrasound, labs, and often FNA when nodules or compressive symptoms warrant removal. Head-and-neck or endocrine surgeons handle hemithyroidectomy and total thyroidectomy; endocrinology manages hormones around the decision.

## Common triggers
- Suspicious or growing nodules after FNA
- Compressive symptoms (swallowing, positional breath issues)
- Confirmed cancer pathways needing surgery
- Selected hyperthyroidism cases not controlled medically
- Retrosternal goitre evaluations

Cosmetic neck-lift marketing is not a thyroid pathway — insist on proper cytology and vocal-cord risk discussion.

## Risks to understand
Recurrent laryngeal nerve injury, hypoparathyroidism (calcium issues), and lifelong thyroxine after total removal are standard counselling points. Ask about neuromonitoring, scar care in humid climates, and who adjusts levothyroxine post-op.

## How to choose
Prefer teams that present multidisciplinary tumour-board logic for cancer cases and clear calcium follow-up protocols. Bring overseas ultrasound disks. Insurance often needs pre-auth with histology codes when known.

## Practical tip
Record your voice before surgery for comparison. Stock calcium instructions in writing before discharge — night tetany panic is avoidable with a clear escalation plan.
whenToEngage: Nodule FNA results point toward surgery
Compressive goitre symptoms need surgical review
Post-op thyroxine and scar-care plan unclear
